attributes.name: Sales Onboarding
attributes.description: Standard onboarding template for new sales hires

tasks.title: Equipment & CRM setup
tasks.description: Deliver laptop, phone, set up Salesforce/CRM access
tasks.notes: Verify CRM permissions and data access

tasks.title: Company & product training
tasks.description: Overview of company mission, product features, competitive landscape

tasks.title: Sales process & playbook review
tasks.description: Learn deal stages, qualification process, negotiation strategies
tasks.notes: Review case studies of closed deals

tasks.title: Customer shadowing
tasks.description: Shadow senior sales rep on calls and meetings
tasks.notes: Multiple calls with different customer profiles

tasks.title: Territory & lead assignment
tasks.description: Assign territory, warm leads, initial pipeline
tasks.notes: Start with inbound leads if new to market

tasks.title: First client meeting
tasks.description: Make first independent client call with manager support
